meaning: This package is for human review only - it is not a tradeable instruction.
No orders are created, staged, or sent anywhere by this harness.
Nothing is automated; every position is human approve/reject gated.
A human must individually approve or reject each candidate.
Paper-only; no live capital, no broker, no execution.
No broker connection exists or is configured by this phase.
No Paper Trader signals or trade decisions are written.
Quarterly rebalance is a manual, reviewed decision - never scheduled execution.
